front.title: MCP Parameter Risk Classes for Machine-Readable Risk Metadata

abstract.t:
This document defines a fixed set of five canonical MCP parameter risk classes: semantic categories for sensitive parameters that appear in the JSON Schemas of Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool definitions, together with deterministic decision rules and boundary conditions for assigning those labels. The classes are designed to supply machine-readable, pre-invocation risk metadata about tool inputs, independent of any particular gateway, routing, or capability-profile specification.
The classes and their decision rules were derived from, and applied against, a SHA-256-frozen empirical census of publicly reachable MCP servers. The frozen census and the classification suite that implements these rules are archived on Zenodo; the archived suite is the normative tie-breaker for exact matching behaviour.
This is an Informational, individual submission. It defines the canonical classes and decision rules. Other specifications MAY cite this document as the canonical source of the class labels and MAY define their own operators that consume those labels; they SHOULD NOT re-derive or inline the normative decision rules into their own normative text.
